name: בֶּרֶכְיָה
summary: Borne by several men: the father of the prophet Zechariah (Zec 1:1, 7); the father of Asaph the singer (1Ch 6:24; 15:17); a son of Zerubbabel (1Ch 3:20); a Levite son of Asa (1Ch 9:16); a gatekeeper for the ark (1Ch 15:23); an Ephraimite chief who stood against the army returning with captives of Judah (2Ch 28:12); and the father of Meshullam who repaired the wall (Neh 3:4, 30; 6:18). Its longer form יְבֶרֶכְיָהוּ, Jeberechiah, is the father of the Zechariah whom Isaiah took as a faithful witness (Isa 8:2). The name is the verb with the divine name, יָה or יָהוּ; the full form keeps the prefix of the imperfect יְבָרֵךְ, as in the priests' “Yahweh bless you (יְבָרֶכְךָ יַהְוֶה)” (Num 6:24): “Yah blesses”, or “may Yah bless”. Scripture does not explain it. The New Testament has the name in Greek, Βαραχίας, as the father of the Zechariah of Mat 23:35.

evidence.note: “Uriah the priest, and Zechariah בֶּן יְבֶרֶכְיָהוּ”: the full form, with the imperfect's prefix.
“The word of Yahweh came to Zechariah בֶּן־בֶּרֶכְיָה בֶּן־עִדּוֹ the prophet.”
The Levites appointed Asaph son of Berechiah among the singers.
“Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers for the ark.”
Among the sons of Zerubbabel's line: “Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah.”
“Berechiah son of Asa son of Elkanah”, a Levite.
“Berechiah son of Meshillemoth” among the heads of Ephraim who stood against those coming from the war.
“Meshullam son of Berechiah son of Meshezabel repaired.”
Tobiah's son had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
The verb in the form the full name keeps: “יְבָרֶכְךָ יַהְוֶה.”
“Zechariah son of Barachiah (Βαραχίου), whom you killed between the temple and the altar.”

note: b.dd.ah (12 tokens) holds both spellings; BDB's b.dd.ai (בֶּרֶכְיָה, 0 tokens) is a cross-reference and is left out. TIPNR keys: 1Ch.6.39 is Hebrew 1Ch 6:24 (and 15:17); Neh 3:30 and 6:18 belong to Berechiah@Neh.3.4; Zec 1:7 to Berechiah@Zec.1.1. It is not checked which TIPNR record holds the gatekeeper of 1Ch 15:23; if it is a person not listed here, add him. TIPNR tags the Zechariah of Mat 23:35 as Zechariah son of Jehoiada (2Ch 24:20–22), not as a son of Berechiah, so no NT person is added; the verse is cited only for the Greek form of the name. Phoenician names of the same type, the verb and a god's name: BRKBʿL, BRKMLQRT (Krahmalkov p. 127).
